practice.foundation[0]: The booklet never asks students to select a minimum set of side measurements. Inferring equal opposite sides within a perimeter calculation does not establish this question type.
practice.foundation[1]: The booklet asks for square perimeters, not the minimum number of measurements needed.
practice.foundation[2]: Selecting required labelled lengths is not asked in the booklet; knowing all three lengths is an intermediate requirement of its perimeter calculations.
practice.foundation[3]: The booklet does not ask for the minimum number of measurements. The structure slug also incorrectly describes a square rather than a rhombus.
practice.foundation[4]: The booklet does not ask students to select sufficient measurements for a parallelogram. The structure slug also describes a rectangle.
practice.foundation[5]: Selecting required measurements is not a booklet question type. The structure slug also describes a scalene triangle rather than a quadrilateral.
practice.development[0]: The booklet does not ask whether repeated side measurements provide enough information for perimeter.
practice.development[1]: Removing a redundant measurement label is not asked in the booklet.
practice.development[2]: Selecting sufficient measurements is not asked in the booklet. The structure slug also describes a kite rather than an isosceles triangle.
practice.development[3]: The booklet asks for a hexagon's perimeter at lines 1206–1211, not the number of additional measurements needed.
practice.development[4]: Choosing an additional side to measure is not asked in the booklet.
practice.development[5]: The booklet does not ask students to select sufficient measurements for a kite.
practice.mastery[0]: Removing a redundant measurement label is not a booklet question type.
practice.mastery[1]: Counting minimum measurements across shapes is not asked in the booklet.
practice.mastery[2]: Identifying an additional measurement for a parallelogram is not asked in the booklet.
quiz.q1: Selecting a minimum sufficient set of measurements is not a booklet question type.
quiz.q2: The booklet does not ask for the minimum number of square side measurements.
quiz.q3: Selecting required labelled lengths is not asked in the booklet.
quiz.q4: Counting additional regular-polygon measurements is not asked in the booklet.
quiz.q5: Counting minimum kite measurements is not asked in the booklet.

quiz.q6: Choosing a minimum additional measurement is not asked in the booklet. The distractor 'the other horizontal side length' also refers to an unmeasured horizontal side although both are already measured; its explanation correctly identifies the repetition.
summary: Replaced all unsupported measurement-selection tasks with cited booklet perimeter questions using equal sides and outside edges, preserving tier counts and quiz ids. Repaired the theory and existing worked examples to teach the resulting procedure, and checked every numerical answer and distractor.
reviewSummary: All 25 items have correct answers, consistent givens and supported booklet question types within the target skill. The theory and worked procedures are sound, every quiz has exactly one correct option with accurate distractor explanations, and no removals were proposed.
